Severe Thunderstorm Warning for DAMAGING WINDS, LARGE HAILSTONES and HEAVY RAINFALL

parts of Goldfields, Eucla and South Interior districts.

Issued at 7:02 pm Western Standard Time

Severe thunderstorms about southern parts of WA this evening.

Weather Situation: Severe thunderstorms are continuing along a surface trough in a moist and unstable environment.

Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds, large hailstones and heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding over the next several hours in parts of the Goldfields, Eucla and South Interior districts. Locations which may be affected include Eyre, Rawlinna and Cocklebiddy.

Safety advice

If outside find safe shelter away from trees, power lines, storm water drains and streams.
